generatedProse.practice-connection: From here, writing with argument is something you do in every module across the School of Sport. Each essay you shape around one case, each paragraph where your own voice leads the sources, each judgement you signal rather than leave implied, is this course at work. It is also what research and professional practice in sport reward: clear, reasoned, well-evidenced writing that takes a position and defends it, whether you end up in the lab, on the training ground, in rehab practice or in sport policy.
